nodes.summary: Manifolds with complex, almost complex, symplectic or contact structures, Riemann surfaces, and integrable Hamiltonian systems.
nodes.title: Complex and symplectic geometry

nodes.summary: Convex sets and convex bodies in Euclidean space: Helly-type and Radon-type theorems, partitions, sections, valuations and linear optimization over polyhedra.
nodes.title: Convex geometry

nodes.summary: Curvature, tangents and global properties of curves and surfaces in Euclidean space, including knotted curves and inscribed figures.
nodes.title: Differential geometry of curves and surfaces

nodes.summary: Smooth manifolds and smooth maps between them: immersions, submersions, transversality, Morse theory, neighbourhood theorems and smooth structures.
nodes.title: Differential topology

nodes.summary: Finite point configurations and their distances, polytopes and polyhedra, dissections and tilings, lattice points and extremal shape problems.
nodes.title: Discrete geometry

nodes.summary: Classical synthetic and metric geometry of the Euclidean plane and space: triangles, circles, conics, polygons, isometries and the foundations of geometry.
nodes.title: Euclidean geometry

nodes.summary: Geometry of general metric spaces: curvature bounds via comparison, length spaces, isometric embeddings and low-distortion embeddings.
nodes.title: Metric geometry

nodes.summary: Optimal arrangements of congruent bodies in space and the smallest sets or fewest translates needed to cover given families of shapes.
nodes.title: Packings and coverings

nodes.summary: Manifolds with smoothly varying inner products or norms on tangent spaces: connections, curvature, geodesics, differential operators and rigidity theorems.
nodes.title: Riemannian and Finsler geometry

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
